speaker: margery_pell
text: Thin. Too many caps pulled down. I don't like a quiet house in June, and I am not naming a box.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A thin Errors, then. Thou wert in it, Will, and so was I, and the yard heard us as if we were next door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They heard us. That is the whole of the afternoon I will claim. What is the paper in your cousin's hand, Sly?

speaker: will_sly
text: Not my hand. My cousin's. Three weeks old, and it has been in a pocket since. A place in Monaghan. Tyrone's men fell on Sir Henry Bagenal's column, the one marching to relieve a fort, and mauled it two days running.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two days. And the numbers?

speaker: will_sly
text: I do not believe the numbers. I will not read a figure aloud that I would not swear to.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A relief column is the worst place God made.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Say the rest, George. You have the face of a man who has seen the edge of one.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I have seen a war from the edge, and I have nothing to add to the sentence. What came by his cousin's letter is one thing. What strangers have added since is another. Keep them apart.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am keeping them apart. I am not writing a number of the dead. Nobody at this table is sure of one.

speaker: will_sly
text: His cousin says Tyrone was trained in the English manner. That much he writes as a thing he thinks he knows. The rest of the sheet swells.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then take the training, and leave the swelling. There is talk, besides, that he is to be proclaimed traitor. Talk is not the letter.

speaker: hired_men
text: And talk, this side, of pressing men for Ireland before harvest. I had that on the road, not from the cousin. I would not put it in his letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is not in the letter. Leave it as talk. Sly, fold the sheet. I have the two days, and the place, and I have no figure.

speaker: will_sly
text: Folded. I told you I do not believe it. A man can carry a letter and still refuse the sum at the foot.

speaker: hired_men
text: From over the water, since you are refusing sums. A new play at the Rose today. A second part of Caesar. I saw the bill. I did not see the play, and I brought no receipt.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Rome sells.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let it sell over the water. I have nothing to set beside that title.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Their stair is not mine. I can tell you this yard was thin. I will not tell you theirs, and I will not invent a price to keep the sentence tidy.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Good. The cousin's letter is a household's letter. The bill is a bill. The pressing of men is tavern talk. Three piles. Do not make them one story tonight.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art very quiet, Will, for a man who has had Rome offered him. Hast thou no word for Caesar at all?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the word I have already said. No number. No second story. The Errors was thin, and this letter is three weeks old, and I am going home with both of those and with nothing written under them.

speaker: will_sly
text: Then take the manner, if you take anything. English-trained. That is my cousin, not the men who improved him on the road.

speaker: hired_men
text: I improved nothing. A second part of Caesar. That is the bill, and the bill is the end of what I know.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And it is the end of what I will carry. God give you a quiet chain on the gate. I have a stair to get to.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go, then. Rome can sell without thee for one night. I will not make thee admire it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Home by the same road you came. And do not stop to collect a better number on the way. There is not one.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I'll lock my box with no figure in the telling. Thin is the word I am willing to leave you.
